commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"; echo "root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; git branch --show-current; git check-ignore .prflow/tmp/x >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "tmp IGNORED" || echo "tmp NOT_IGNORED (rc=$?)"

printf 'GITHUB_ACTIONS=%s
' "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"; printf 'root=%s
' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; printf 'branch='; git branch --show-current; git check-ignore .prflow/tmp/x >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "tmp IGNORED" || echo "tmp NOT_IGNORED"; printf 'session=%s
' "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-<unset>}"
DEVFLOW_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; echo "root=$DEVFLOW_ROOT"; mkdir -p "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body"; echo ok

gh issue view 1640 --json body --jq '.body' > /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1640.md; wc -c /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1640.md; head -c 40 /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1640.md
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh base_branch 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "no origin HEAD"
git grep -n "draft PR number" -- skills/implement/phases/ | head; echo "---1.5---"; git grep -n "push -u" -- skills/implement/phases/phase-1*.md | head

gh api --method PATCH "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/1641" -F body=@/home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/pr-1641-body.md --jq '.number' && echo "---CHECK PLACEHOLDER---" && (gh pr view 1641 --json body --jq '.body' | grep -q "Work in progress — automated review pending" && echo "STILL-PLACEHOLDER" || echo "UPDATED")
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/run-jq.sh -r '.comment.id // empty' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "(event comment id above; empty means resolve via listing)"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
